title: Define v2 IPC/HTTP fixture contract
summary: Adding concrete v2 fixtures requires an intentional protocol bump and is human-owned. Before that decision, define the *contract* a v2 fixture pair must satisfy (file layout, naming, schema-version field, migration-note format) as docs + a validator that runs only when v2 fixtures appear. Keeps the protocol-bump decision human-gated while making the eventual landing deterministic.
expectedFailureModes: v2 fixtures land later with inconsistent file layouts because the contract was never written down.
The validator is over-eager and fires on legacy v1 fixtures, blocking unrelated work.
docs/status.md is updated to imply v2 fixtures exist before the protocol bump decision is made.
humanEscalation: The actual decision to bump the IPC/HTTP protocol to v2 and publish v2 fixtures remains human-owned.
nextAction: Document the v2 IPC/HTTP fixture contract in docs/ipc-and-http-gateway.md (file layout, schema-version field, migration-note pairing rules), implement a validator that no-ops when no v2 fixture exists and fails with a clear remediation when the contract is violated, and link from docs/status.md without claiming v2 fixtures ship.
